display.title: Episode 145: Saved by a Miracle, Chapter 2 (Erev Sukkos)
display.summary_short: Before Sukkos, Uncle Yossi describes the miracles of the Clouds of Glory in the desert, and the story ends: the Alter Rebbe's strange advice to wait a week saves Reb Boruch's life.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the day before Erev Sukkos. Uncle Yossi explains that the s'chach of the sukkah recalls the Clouds of Glory that protected the Bnei Yisroel for forty years in the desert: shade by day and a pillar of fire by night, a soft path over sharp stones, mountains flattened, clothes and shoes that were cleaned and grew with their owners, manna from heaven that tasted like anything you wished, and a rock that gave water and followed them. The s'chach teaches us to trust that Hashem feeds and supports everyone. After the Hakochainik march and a recap of last week's chapter, two brothers who bought letters in the children's Sefer Torah lead the Shema. The story concludes: the Alter Rebbe now tells Reb Boruch to go to the minister, who greets him with joy. Officials had ordered that he be shot when he arrived the week before, but because he did not come, witnesses had time to reveal that Alex framed him. Reb Boruch gets his job back with a raise. The show ends with the Shofar Gadol contest, the Great Sukkah Experience, reminders to eat in the sukkah, bentch on the four kinds and share them with others, and a refuah shleimah update.
display.lesson: Things that look puzzling to us are clear through the eyes of a tzaddik; trust Hashem, who protects and provides for us as He did in the desert.
